desc:
🌍 Welcome to Steal a Countryball!
😎 Troll, steal, and become the strongest countryball player!

👍 Like the game and join our group to claim your reward!
⭐ Group members also get access to exclusive codes!

🕹️ How to Play:
🎈 Buy your own Countryball
🕵️ Steal Countryballs from other players
🔁 Rebirth to increase your strength
🎭 Get troll tools and trawl gear to prank others!

📊 Check how much others are earning
❤️ Show your support with Likes and Favorites!

🖥️ Works on PC, Mobile, and Tablet!
🧠 Inspired by Steal a Brainrot

⚠️ CHEATERS WILL BE PERMANENTLY BANNED WITH NO HESITATION, DO NOT CHEAT OR YOU WILL BE BANNED. ⚠️
